name: SPE — System Prompt Engine
description: Free-first tools for AI creation, software development, design, prompt engineering, agent skills, workflows, and evaluation.

capabilities.name: AI Creation & System Prompt Studio
capabilities.description: Turn ideas into structured system prompts, preserve declared constraints, and transcompile to 11 model dialects privately in-browser.
capabilities.free_tier_entitlement: Free client-side WebAssembly compiler with output ceiling up to 30,000 characters.

capabilities.name: Screenshot to Code Prompt Studio
capabilities.description: Convert visual screenshots, mockups, or UI components into structured frontend implementation prompts and starter scaffolds.

capabilities.name: 3D Website Studio & Component Generator
capabilities.description: Explore interactive website specifications, design tokens, Three.js 3D scenes, and responsive layout architectures.
capabilities.free_tier_entitlement: Free in-browser preview and code export.

capabilities.name: UI Drop & Design System Analyzer
capabilities.description: Analyze web UI designs, extract visual hierarchy, color palettes, and typography into structured system prompt instructions.

capabilities.name: AI Agent Skill Creator
capabilities.description: Create, format, and audit reusable agent skills (SKILL.md) conforming to Anthropic, Antigravity, and MCP standards.
keywords: build a reusable AI agent skill
capabilities.free_tier_entitlement: Free in-browser skill authoring and packaging.

capabilities.name: 1-Click AI Workflow Catalog
capabilities.description: Curated catalog of battle-tested AI engineering workflows for coding agents, code reviews, documentation, and architecture audits.
capabilities.free_tier_entitlement: Free unlimited workflow access and 1-click execution.

capabilities.name: Verified Prompt Arsenal
capabilities.description: Search and download verified system prompt specifications across 13 engineering domains with AST schemas and invariant guarantees.
capabilities.free_tier_entitlement: Free public access to verified catalog prompts.

capabilities.name: Daily Prompt Engineering Lab
capabilities.description: Daily prompt engineering challenges, frontier reasoning exercises, and hands-on prompt calibration sandboxes.
keywords: give me creative ideas for AI
capabilities.free_tier_entitlement: Free daily lab access and interactive sandbox.

capabilities.name: Prompt Vault & Engineering Workspace
capabilities.description: Local-first prompt management workspace with version history, tag filtering, and air-gapped encrypted browser storage.

capabilities.name: Audio & Speech-to-Prompt Ingestion
capabilities.description: Client-side audio transcription and voice brief processing using in-browser Web Audio API and local ONNX runtime.
keywords: turn audio or video into text
capabilities.free_tier_entitlement: Free on devices supporting Web Audio API and WebAssembly.
capabilities.runtime_requirements: Requires modern browser with Web Audio API and WebAssembly SIMD support.

capabilities.name: Visual Document & Image OCR Studio
capabilities.description: Extract text, code snippets, and diagrams from screenshots and documents directly in-browser using local canvas and ONNX models.
capabilities.free_tier_entitlement: Free on devices supporting client-side canvas and ONNX WebAssembly.
capabilities.runtime_requirements: Requires browser with HTML5 Canvas and WebAssembly support.

capabilities.name: Multi-Model Dialect Compare Arena
capabilities.description: Head-to-head dialect syntax diffing, token budget comparisons, and constraint preservation audits across 11 frontier model formats.
capabilities.free_tier_entitlement: Free side-by-side AST and dialect comparison.

capabilities.name: Pro Studio & Continuous Brain Evolution
capabilities.description: Advanced live model evaluation, continuous automated brain evolution, team workspaces, and high-volume programmatic API gateway.
capabilities.free_tier_entitlement: Free sandbox preview; production automated pipelines and team governance require Pro tier.
